name: ClinePass

price.note: Standard price after an intro promo. A processing fee may apply.

reset.rule: A rolling 5-hour window. Cline doesn't say whether it starts at first use.
stipulations: Cline publishes no numbers, only that limits are 2 to 5 times the standard API rate limits.
Some models have peak and off-peak rates. Cline doesn't define the hours.

reset.rule: Resets each calendar week. Cline doesn't say which day or time zone.
Resets each calendar month. Cline doesn't say which time zone.

overage: Cline doesn't document what happens at a limit, and the pass has no paid overage. Pay-as-you-go Cline credits at provider cost are a separate option.

how: A flat monthly pass for open-weight models, with 5-hour, weekly and monthly limits. Cline publishes no limit sizes.
ext: Open-weight models only: DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax, MiMo, Qwen and Muse Spark. No Claude, GPT or Gemini.
An OpenAI-compatible API at api.cline.bot/api/v1 lets other tools use the pass. Create a key under Settings → API Keys.
quirks: GLM-5.2, Kimi K2.6, Kimi K2.7 Code and DeepSeek V4 Flash were removed for capacity. The marketing page still lists some of them.
Non-streaming API calls need the header X-Response-Format: openai.
The first month costs $4.99 (third-party report, unconfirmed).
